name: 55-t20-pan-night-gain-unreachable
incident: 2026-10-07 Wyze Pan v1 (T20/jxf22, OpenIMP, timps cf968e4): Day all night in a pitch-dark cellar
description: The AE stops at its published analog cap (MAX SENSOR analog gain 128 = 16x = 4096) with the ISP digital gain at 0 of 32 and the integration time at 1967 of 2246 lines (87.6 %), so the exposure index plateaus at 4096 x 0.8758 = 3587 - measured on 3528 of 3574 trace samples that night, snapshot mean Y 6.6. `s > night_gain` (4096) can never hold, and the 32 unused ISP digital-gain units count as AE reserve, so the railed path never fires either: the camera stayed in day all night. The dump is the T20 isp_info shape (no SENSOR Max Integration Time; the ratio comes from GetExpr). With the reachable-maximum rule the cap proves 4096 out of reach, and the plateau held at the cap for day_confirm_s switches to night: one switch after the boot measurement, one warning naming the numbers. The night pipeline (IR on) and the illuminator-off reading are modelled, so the heartbeat's silent probes find night without a click.

expect_log: switching to night \(exposure 35\d\d at its reachable plateau 35\d\d\)
